description: Simulated multi-omics ground truth for TorchGWAS Genome Biology paper Figure 4 panel A. G -> expr -> trait with sparse beta_GE, sparse beta_ET, a pleiotropic direct-effect component, and a non-causal coloc/SMR negative control.

definition.twas_z_corr_pearson: Pearson correlation of recovered TWAS z-scores against truth.twas_z_truth across all m genes; must be >= floor.
definition.smr_beta_relative_error: max over causal mediators of |b_smr_hat - smr_beta_truth| / |smr_beta_truth|; must be <= floor.
definition.coloc_pp_h4_min_for_causal: min over causal mediators of recovered PP.H4; must be >= floor. Negative-control mediators must have PP.H4 < 0.5.
definition.mediation_ab_relative_error: max over causal mediators of |ab_hat - mediation_ab_truth| / |mediation_ab_truth|; must be <= floor.

references.smr: Zhu et al. 2016 Nat. Genet. 48:481-487 (SMR + HEIDI)
references.susie: Wang et al. 2020 J. R. Stat. Soc. B 82:1273-1300
